title: Schema migrations
body: Decided with Jack: a chain of untyped N to N+1 steps over serde_json::Value in the binary, run on read so looking never writes; the ref's meta.json bumped to the binary's schema on the first write by a newer binary, with an obvious coloured message; a window of three schemas back, beyond which the gate names the foam version to go through; stats and doctor show the ref's schema and the binary's; meta.json takes the higher schema on merge; one frozen fixture per schema under tests/ and a test that the chain reads each. An upgrade is walked back by a revert commit on the ref, which fast-forwards everywhere.
close_reason: every child closed; the chain, the bump, the window, the reporting, the merge rule, the fixture and the sync gate are in
